title: Total-torque reference with a 400-epoch limit (epoch-limit check)
description: Epoch-limit check for total torque: the total-torque reference (WT1_total) with the limit raised from 150 to 400 epochs (fast400 protocol), 6 people x 2 seeds, compared with WT1_total on the same people and seeds by session-1 validation loss. The 150-epoch limit was chosen on active torque only, and many total-torque runs stop at the limit. Everything else as WT1_total.
